# Salvage Specialist
1. You report directly to the Salvage Lead and should communicate with the Salvage Lead before and after each expedition with a verbal status report. After every 2 expeditions or if the salvage crew must return sooner, a formal docking procedure must be completed.
This procedure is as follows: - The salvage team will notify the Salvage Lead of their intent to return to the station. - Any weaponry found is to be stored safely aboard the ATS. - Any salvage materials found should be sorted to be sold to the station. - Any damage to the ship/crew must be repaired.
2. Salvage's primary directive is the defense and upkeep of the Automated Trade Station.
- Intruders onboard the ATS may be apprehended by Salvage, and should be turned over to Station Security without delay once incapacitated. - Hostile threats actively causing damage to the ATS may be dispatched by Salvage, but should not be pursued once they are no longer an active threat to the ATS. - The Automated Trade Station should remain powered, breathable, and pressurized at all times. - The Automated Trade Station should not be moved closer or further from the assigned Space Station at any time unless it is for the preservation of the ATS from extreme damages. - The ATS may be used as shelter in times of great emergency. Outside of these scenarios, it is an asset of the Trade Guild and should not be used for non-commerce related tasks by anyone but the Salvage team guarding it.
3. Highly dangerous expeditions may only be undertaken with the express permission of the Salvage Lead. Going on unauthorized expeditions is grounds for demotion.
4. Salvage operators are not to bring weapons, or support station operations/defense without being explicitly authorized by ITG via secure console.
6. Salvage Specialists are to follow the orders of the Salvage Lead during any active operation.
7. Machinery, Equipment, and weaponry should not be taken from the station. Salvage are expected to operate independently to minimize ITG liabilities.
